note: Adds arXiv and a few open-access mathematics sources. Third-party papers: for private/offline builds, not a public deploy.

rules.name: no-paywalls
rules.note: Publisher landing pages, paywalls and indexes: never PDFs we may fetch. Also blocks redirects into these hosts (e.g. via doi.org).

rules.name: arxiv
rules.note: ~15,500 papers. arxiv.org/robots.txt sets Crawl-delay: 15 (export.arxiv.org disallows crawling entirely), so a full run takes ~2.7 days; it is resumable.

rules.name: open-access-journals
rules.note: Theory and Applications of Categories, NUMDAM, EMIS (incl. Documenta Mathematica), CORE: open-access PDFs linked directly from nLab pages.

rules.name: web-archive
rules.note: Archived copies of dead links; the Internet Archive rate-limits aggressively.
